Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card’s inherited effect even if my opponent's Digimon and the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards are deleted at the same timing?

Effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon is suspended, it gets +3000 DP.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
